test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: For what value of k, the system of equations kx - 15y + 7 = 0 and 7x - 21y - 19 = 0 has NO solution?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a system of linear equations to have no solution, the ratio of x-coefficients must equal the ratio of y-coefficients.

a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂

k / 7 = −15 / −21

k = 7 × (5 / 7) = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation 1: kx − 15y + 7 = 0

Equation 2: 7x − 21y − 19 = 0

**Formula Used:**

For two linear equations a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 and a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0 to have NO solution, the condition is:

a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ ≠ c₁ / c₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ Comparing the given equations with the standard form, we get:

⇒ a₁ = k, b₁ = −15, c₁ = 7

⇒ a₂ = 7, b₂ = −21, c₂ = −19

⇒ Applying the condition for no solution:

⇒ k / 7 = (−15) / (−21)

⇒ k / 7 = 15 / 21

⇒ k / 7 = 5 / 7

⇒ k = 5

⇒ Checking the second part of the condition:

⇒ b₁ / b₂ = 5 / 7

⇒ c₁ / c₂ = 7 / (−19)

⇒ 5 / 7 ≠ −7 / 19 (Condition satisfied)

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Condition for Unique Solution (Intersecting Lines)

The system of equations has exactly one solution if a₁ / a₂ ≠ b₁ / b₂.

Condition for Infinitely Many Solutions (Coincident Lines)

The system has infinitely many solutions if all ratios are equal: a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ = c₁ / c₂.

Condition for No Solution (Parallel Lines)

The system has no solution if the lines are strictly parallel: a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ ≠ c₁ / c₂.
